answer: Require each agent identity to post a refundable stake locked for a full voyage through several epochs, while its attestations are cross-checked by independent peers: if duplicate identities echo the same work or share a device fingerprint, the stake is slashed. Like layers of shale, trust builds only from distinct, time-separated contributions — a sybil attacker must therefore fund, age, and operate each fake separately, so creating thousands costs thousands of stakes plus months of distinct activity, while one honest agent pays once.
